current_comparator_contract.polarity: DRV SP=GND_SYS, SN=SC_MINUS; cap charging makes SO fall, cap discharge makes SO rise. Do not reverse the control-loop sign.
current_comparator_contract.COMP1: PB1 versus DAC3_CH1; fixed lower hard-fault window, active-low external fault output; internal TIM1 Break enabled.
current_comparator_contract.COMP2: PA7 versus DAC3_CH2; fixed upper hard-fault window, active-low external fault output; internal TIM1 Break enabled.
current_comparator_contract.COMP3: PA0 versus DAC1_CH1; inverted output detects charging-current peak and clears TIM1 OCREF through the internal mux (RM0440 Table272). Not connected to the ISO FF clear.
current_comparator_contract.charge_example: At CORE=3.3V, gain20 and0.5mOhm: SO=1.65-0.01*I_charge. 25A gives1.40V. This is a nominal conversion, not an error-free hardware threshold.
current_comparator_contract.Break: AOE=0. Serious faults stay off pending explicit ARM; cycle regulation uses OCREF clear, never automatic Break rearm.
current_comparator_contract.asynchronous_stage: During 0..2V stack OCV charging, keep CH1N disabled and INL low apart from the bounded bootstrap sequence; COMP3 clearing CH1 must not turn on the complementary low-side output.
current_comparator_contract.normal_charge: At higher voltage permit synchronous freewheel only while current stays positive; cap charge command at most30A before temperature/voltage derating, peak control adjustable, use50A for data-age OV budget.

bootstrap_contract.sequence: After healthy rails/AFE and ARM, high-side held off. Apply150 low-side input pulses of2us at100us intervals, then both PWM inputs low before beginning high-side current packets.
bootstrap_contract.conditions: Stack<=19.6V, BUS>=22.5V, effective bootstrap C>=0.5uF, nominal1uF tolerance upper1.1uF, 12V supply minimum11.4V. Clear any fault rather than continuing this sequence.
bootstrap_contract.reason: Avoid a continuous50us low-side bootstrap pulse across a charged supercapacitor; at19.6V/12.8uH it could establish about77A reverse current.
bootstrap_contract.calculation: A2.08us maximum low pulse screens to3.19A reverse peak at19.6V/12.8uH. The100us interval exceeds the return-to-BUS diode decay estimate. Final bootstrap target>=9.7V; a500nC engineering charge budget into0.5uF leaves>=8.7V.
bootstrap_contract.limit: Qg at12V, actual input-to-channel timing, bootstrap diode charging and biased capacitance must satisfy these budgets. These are schematic qualification constraints, not claimed min/max values absent from a vendor table. Never bootstrap with unbounded low-side ON time.

power_off_boundary.steady_state: TMUX VDD<1.5V signal pins remain within0..3.6V; atVDD0 its full-temperature leakage<=2uA. Four host10k pulldowns limit corresponding MCU DC inputs to20.02mV in the leakage model.
power_off_boundary.transient: Use supervisor WD_OK to open channels while CORE is still valid. The4us supply-off timing is specified for a1us supply ramp, not every possible regulator collapse. Board3V3 waveform, pin transient and supply hold-up must meet the handoff envelope.
power_off_boundary.BUS_ADC: Two10k shunts and300k upper leg produce nominal1:61 while on, not1:31; firmware/calibration contract changes accordingly. At3.3V/12bit one BUS LSB is about49.15mV, before oversampling.
power_off_boundary.other_inputs: NTC pullups and TCAN332 useCORE. AUP and LVC buffers must retain Ioff. MAX CSB pullup staysAFE-side; SDO and CSB cross the switch. SCLK/SDI remain SPI inputs with host-series resistors and noAFE-side pullup to an alive rail.
power_off_boundary.not_covered: External harness shorts toBUS, fast charge injection and arbitrary3V3 collapse are separate transient/fault cases; a steady-state leakage calculation is not a blanket electrical-stress PASS.
